title: Summer Sunset Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home's layout is meticulously planned to enhance your stay, starting from the airy first floor with its breathtaking Gulf views to the tranquility of the second-floor bedrooms, each with its own charm and direct views of the shimmering waters. Whether it's sipping coffee on the balcony as the sun rises over the Gulf, enjoying a meal together at the spacious dining table, or simply stepping out onto the white sands for a day of sun-soaked relaxation, this property provides the perfect backdrop for making lasting memories. The inclusion of modern amenities like a fully stocked kitchen and a private pool area, complete with a grill station for outdoor dining, ensures every moment is filled with comfort and convenience. This beachfront haven is not just a place to stay; it's a luxurious experience, offering a seamless blend of relaxation, privacy, and access to the natural beauty of the Emerald Coast.
